stemMd: A fair six-sided die is rolled once. Given that the result is even, what is the probability it is greater than 3?
explanationMd: Conditioning on even leaves the equally likely outcomes 2, 4 and 6. Two of these, 4 and 6, are greater than 3, so the conditional probability is 2/3. Rebuild the sample space before counting favourable outcomes.

distractorRationale.c: This ignores the condition restricting the sample space.
distractorRationale.b: This divides the two favourable even results by all six outcomes.
distractorRationale.a: This counts only one outcome and uses the unrestricted sample space.
distractorRationale.e: The even result 2 is not greater than 3.
